notes.title: New patch: achievements & bug fixed
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40301284/d1d4316185f0e87c5bc8f54e0dffdad0c977ac8d.png[/img]

Hi Gatekeepers,

A new patch for [i]KINGDOM of the DEAD[/i] is now available for download, which includes bug fixing and additional improvements.

Here’s the [b]changelog[/b]:

[list]
[*]Fixed issue with 3 Steam achievements not registering ([i]"Paths of Gory[/i]", "[i]Blood on the Tracks[/i]", and "[i]Misty Mountain Drop[/i]")
[*]Fixed issue with bat boss area damage being randomly reduced 
[*]Fixed issue with 2nd and 3rd save slots showing wrong check for endless mode
[*]Map tweaks & visual adjustments[/list]
Thank you for your patience!

See you in the abyss.

- Camilla from HOOK

notes.title: NEW UPDATE: Endless mode, Achievements, and more.
notes.notes:
Gatekeepers, it’s time to survive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40301284/b294087dd5985ddef4803756f685e58a13e4eb60.png[/img]

A new [b]UPDATE [/b]for [i]KINGDOM of the DEAD[/i] is now available for download, which includes a [b]new mode[/b], [b]achievements[/b], and additional improvements.

Here’s the [b]changelog[/b]:

[list]
[*]New [b]Endless mode[/b] has been implemented. Survive against as many enemies as you can!
[*]Added Endless mode map.
[*]Added [b]33 new unlockable achievements[/b].
[*][b]Controller support[/b] is now available.
[*]Added several [b]animation improvements[/b].
[*]Several minor bugs were fixed.[/list]
We hope you will jump back into the darkness of KINGDOM of the DEAD to show us your skills and records!

See you in the abyss.

- Camilla from HOOK

notes.title: KINGDOM of the DEAD - release date change
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40301284/993d61c7bb8ca94c7480513e4a2da90f8964ec88.png[/img]

Hi [i]agentis[/i],

To give you the best experience possible in KINGDOM of the DEAD, we have decided to slightly [b]postpone the release[/b] of the game to [b]February 10th, 2022[/b]. This will allow our one-dev-army to polish all the necessary details.

In the meantime, we remind you to add KotD to your [b]wishlist [/b]on Steam while waiting to be able to explore its pits, deep wells and crypts!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1547380/KINGDOM_of_the_DEAD/

Thank you for your instrumental support,

HOOK Team

[i]If you want to find out more about the world of KINGDOM of the DEAD and stay up to date, remember to join the conversation on our [url=https://twitter.com/KOTDGAME]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/KOTDGAME/]Reddit[/url].[/i]

notes.title: KINGDOM of the DEAD Publisher and Release Date
notes.notes:
[i]The gates of the underworld are about to open.[/i]

[previewyoutube=eIHluef2ET4;full][/previewyoutube]

We are excited to announce that [b]KINGDOM of the DEAD[/b] will be coming to Steam on [b]26th January 2022[/b], thanks to the work of one-dev-army [b]DIRIGO Games[/b] and supported by the newborn publisher [b]HOOK[/b], a new division from the Digital Bros Group focused on indie games.
 
As a new and ([i]not so[/i]) big happy family, we want to thank you for the amazing support over the past few weeks and the interest shown in KotD, which we hope you will enjoy in its [i]final form[/i] (yes, [i]much more awaits you[/i]).

[h2]Save the date, [b]wishlist now[/b] and spread the word. [/h2]
[i]It’s almost time to remind Death where it belongs.[/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1547380/KINGDOM_of_the_DEAD/

Join the conversation on [url=https://twitter.com/KOTDGAME]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/KOTDGAME/]Reddit[/url]

DIRIGO Games & HOOK Team
